source.title: extra-eyes normalized context, fan-out, cadence, latency, and API-failure test pass

acquisition.details: Ran `cargo test` after adding normalized conversation ingestion, budgeted watcher context, multi-profile tick/watch fan-out, per-profile cadence, edit-to-hook latency assertions, fast hook-fetch timing assertion, and once-only API failure diagnostics. Result: 21 unit tests passed and 29 integration tests passed. New coverage includes conversation::normalizes_* unit tests; context::budget_context_truncates_diff_and_preserves_recent_conversation; integration tests feed_normalizes_harness_conversation_into_watcher_context, watcher_context_respects_profile_budget, hook_fetch_marks_watcher_origin_and_deduplicates_session with <1s hook fetch, eyes_watch_detects_edit_runs_default_profile_and_hook_fetches_message with <5s edit-to-hook visibility, watch_fans_out_to_multiple_profiles_and_respects_cadence, and watcher_api_failure_is_reported_once_until_recovery.
